description: This file defines Data Transfer Objects (DTOs) related to authentication, including request models for registration and login, as well as a response model containing authentication token and user info.

classes.name: RegisterRequest
classes.description: DTO for user registration requests, containing Username, Email, and Password with validation attributes.

classes.name: LoginRequest
classes.description: DTO for login requests, containing UsernameOrEmail and Password with validation attributes.

classes.name: AuthResponse
classes.description: DTO for authentication response, including Token, Expiry time, and User info.
